cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Warmth with a Countdown
cards.instruction: Perform increasing warmth with increasingly final language, as though every act of care might also be a goodbye.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll pack your food. Take two sandwiches; I want you fed properly after you leave us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm going to the next town for the afternoon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then take the flask too. You can have our tea even when you're not at our table.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can't carry all that. I only brought a small bag.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One sandwich, then. I'll cut it the way you liked as a child, so you leave with something familiar.
